patch_script = """\
from icalendar import Calendar
import os

cal_path = "/workspace/testbed/calendar/alice.ics"
with open(cal_path, "rb") as f:
    cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())

# Rebuild calendar with patched event
new_cal = Calendar()
new_cal.add("prodid", cal.get("prodid", "-//My Calendar Product//mxm.dk//"))
new_cal.add("version", cal.get("version", "2.0"))

for component in cal.walk():
    if component.name == "VEVENT":
        summary = str(component.get("summary", ""))
        if summary == "Project Kickoff Meeting":
            # Patch description and location
            component.pop("description", None)
            component.pop("location", None)
            component.add("description", "Initial meeting to discuss project goals and assign tasks.")
            component.add("location", "Conference Room A")
        new_cal.add_component(component)

with open(cal_path, "wb") as f:
    f.write(new_cal.to_ical())

print("Patched alice.ics successfully.")
"""
